jobs.title: Project Manager II, Early Phase (Bulgaria)
jobs.description:
The Project Manager II, EPTR has the overall responsibility for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of assigned clinical trials. The Project Manager II, EPTR oversees and coordinates study resources to ensure compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements. The Project Manager II, EPTR acts as the main line of communication to relevant stakeholders and provides input to feasibility, study design, budget development and ensures progress reporting (resources, budget and timeline).

More specifically, the Project Manager II, Early Phase and Translational Research (EPTR):

Acts as the main point of contact for sponsors, vendors, and internal study teams throughout the lifecycle of a clinical trial.
Works closely with clients at study start-up to understand their goals and help determine the most effective operational approach.
Maintains regular communication with sponsors, study teams, functional departments, clinical sites, and senior management.
Oversees all operational aspects of clinical trials, including timelines, budgets, resources, vendor management, and clinical operations activities, while coordinating deliverables across departments.
Monitors and controls study budgets by tracking hours, reviewing billed time, identifying out-of-scope activities, and supporting change order management.
Provides regular updates to internal and external stakeholders on study progress, including site selection, vendor management, budgets, timelines, quality standards, and risk mitigation efforts.
Leads study start-up activities, including kick-off meetings, Trial Master File (TMF) setup, site selection and activation, vendor onboarding, site contracting, and budget negotiations.
Identifies and manages risks, implements quality control measures, and escalates issues to management, quality assurance, or sponsors when necessary.
Leads client meetings, internal team meetings, and vendor status calls, ensuring meeting minutes are documented, distributed, and filed appropriately.
Oversees the quality of project deliverables, including vendor and subcontractor outputs, and drives continuous improvement in training, execution, and quality processes.
Evaluates differences between planned and actual project outcomes and implements corrective actions when required.
Ensures study-specific training matrices are customized, maintained, and up to date.
Verifies that all team members and service providers receive adequate project training and that training records remain current.
Reviews and approves responses to quality assurance audits to ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements.
Ensures key study documents and deliverables, such as protocols, informed consent forms, eCRFs, source document templates, tables/listings/figures, and clinical study reports, are completed on schedule and meet study requirements.
Oversees the filing, maintenance, and archiving of study documentation within the TMF in compliance with company SOPs and regulatory requirements.
Provides project status updates while ensuring compliance with budgets, scope, timelines, SOPs, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), regulatory requirements, and study-specific procedures.
Tracks recruitment performance and develops mitigation plans when enrollment timelines are at risk.
Participates in the planning and execution of Investigator Meetings.
Works with Regulatory Affairs to ensure ethics submissions are completed on time and that essential documents are collected and maintained throughout the study.
Ensures the TMF remains complete, accurate, and inspection-ready at all times.
May oversee clinical monitoring activities, including site qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, as well as CRA training and monitoring oversight.
Supports study sites and ensures they have the necessary materials and resources to conduct the study effectively.
Collaborates with Data Management to ensure CRFs meet protocol and sponsor requirements and that data review and query resolution remain on schedule through database lock.
Partners with Clinical Operations to ensure monitoring activities are completed according to sponsor expectations, SOPs, regulations, GCP, and study requirements.
Contributes to the development of Clinical Monitoring Plans.
Provides project-specific training to Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and may conduct site initiation visits for single-site studies.
Develops annotated site visit reports and monitoring tools, including source data verification worksheets.
May mentor junior staff and support the onboarding of new employees.
Provides technical, therapeutic, and project management expertise to support departmental training and process improvement initiatives.
May participate in business development activities, including client meetings, proposal defenses, RFIs, and RFP responses.
May contribute to process improvement initiatives, including the development, testing, and implementation of operational tools and processes.

Requirements:

A Bachelor's degree (B.Sc.) in a field related to clinical research. A Master's degree (M.Sc.) or Ph.D. is considered an asset.
At least 5 years of experience in the clinical research industry, including a minimum of 3 years of project management experience in Phase I and Phase II clinical trials.
Experience managing multiple clinical trials simultaneously across several study sites.
Previous experience in dermatology clinical trials, which is strongly preferred.
Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) guidelines, FDA requirements, and applicable local regulations.
Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Bilingualism in English and French is highly desirable.
The ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment and build strong relationships with colleagues, sponsors, and other stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, and creative-thinking skills.
Solid scientific understanding and clinical research knowledge.
Broad cross-functional knowledge of clinical research operations.
The ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize competing demands, and perform effectively under pressure while meeting deadlines.
Knowledge of Good Clinical Practices as well as applicable Health Canada and FDA regulations and guidelines.

Our company:

﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

Permanent full-time position
Flexible schedule
Vacation
Home-based position
Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Bulgaria

jobs.title: Compliance Enablement Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to serve as the technical subject-matter expert (SME) for the Trust and Assurance team. This role will be responsible for leading the technical side of the compliance automation function of the team. A core part of the role is analyzing controls within the GRC platform to ensure they are accurate, meet framework requirements, and pull the necessary evidence to prove effectiveness. You will also partner with engineering teams to embed compliance into their workflows from the start. Strong compliance framework knowledge, solid program-management skills, and experience with AI technology are essential.

What You Will Do

Serve as the team's technical authority.

Act as the technical SME and primary point of contact for the Trust and Assurance team: interpret how systems and controls work, guide technical decisions, and identify opportunities to make workflows and tooling more efficient.

Manage compliance stack.

Oversee control mapping, evidence collection, and monitoring workflows, and manage the integrations that connect the GRC platform to cloud platforms and internal systems.

Establish control monitoring. Translate technical controls into automated, continuous checks, expanding monitoring coverage across the compliance stack and replacing manual reviews with ongoing monitoring.
Reduce audit burden.

Ensure every control has an accountable owner, support gap assessments and the rollout of new frameworks, and keep controls in a continuously audit-ready state.

Embed compliance into engineering.

Partner with engineering teams to build compliance requirements into their workflows and processes from the start, so compliance is designed in rather than added later.

Drive delivery and keep stakeholders aligned.

Manage initiatives through to completion, and communicate compliance risk, control status, and program progress to technical and non-technical audiences through clear, actionable summaries.

What You Will Bring

4+ years in GRC, compliance, or a technical role supporting cybersecurity programs, including leading programs and guiding or mentoring others.
Strong program and project management skills, with a track record of delivering across multiple teams.
Solid knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and/or FedRAMP) and hands-on audit experience.
Enough technical depth to be the team's technical point of contact: comfortable reasoning about cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), APIs, and data flows, and interpreting technical work with AI assistance, even if you do not write code.

jobs.description:
Description

Purpose

The Senior Program Manager leads the execution and delivery of complex cross-functional programs and projects, ensuring work is planned, coordinated, and delivered in alignment with business objectives, scope, timelines, dependencies, and intended outcomes.

Reporting to the Director, Delivery & Execution, this role partners closely with business leaders, the Strategy Execution Office leadership, Business Analysts, and delivery partners to translate strategic initiative direction into structured execution plans and successful implementation outcomes.

The Senior Program Manager serves as a hands-on execution leader responsible for driving initiatives and projects from concept through implementation, ensuring initiatives move forward with clarity, momentum, and accountability.

This role also contributes to strengthening enterprise delivery capabilities at AAIS by supporting the development and maturation of program and project management practices, tools, and execution disciplines across the organization.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Execution

Lead end-to-end delivery of assigned initiatives and projects from planning through implementation and operational transition.
Translate strategic initiative intent into structured execution plans including scope, milestones, dependencies, and success measures.
Lead assigned enterprise initiatives, multi-workstream programs and projects from planning through delivery.
Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestones, deliverables, and execution rhythms.
Drive day-to-day execution across workstreams to ensure initiatives progress according to plan and deliver intended outcomes.
Ensure initiatives have clear scope, ownership, success measures, dependencies, and decision paths.
Hold teams accountable for milestone completion, deliverables, and execution commitments.
Monitor program health and proactively address risks, issues, blockers, and scope changes.
Escalate material risks, tradeoffs, and execution concerns to delivery leadership as appropriate.
Ensure assigned initiatives deliver agreed scope, timelines, and intended business outcomes.

Planning, Readiness & Delivery Support

Partner with Business Analysts and business stakeholders to translate requirements into executable delivery plans.
Support readiness planning for implementation, operational transition, and adoption activities.
Ensure delivery plans reflect realistic sequencing, resource constraints, and operational impacts.
Support change control and impact assessment as initiatives evolve.
Partner with business and change leaders to support stakeholder readiness, communication, and adoption planning.

Stakeholder Communication & Decision Support

Provide clear, decision-ready reporting on program status, risks, milestones, and dependencies.
Tailor communications for executive, sponsor, and working-team audiences.
Surface tradeoffs and recommendations to support informed decision-making.
Maintain transparency regarding delivery progress and execution confidence.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate work across business, operational, and technology stakeholders to maintain alignment and delivery progress.
Manage dependencies across workstreams, teams, and related initiatives.
Facilitate working sessions, decision meetings, and delivery checkpoints.
Ensure action items, decisions, and follow-through are documented and tracked.

Delivery Standards & Continuous Improvement

Apply SEO delivery standards, templates, and tools consistently across assigned programs.
Support governance and review processes established by the Strategy Execution Office.
Contribute lessons learned and recommendations to strengthen delivery maturity and execution effectiveness.

Delivery Capability Development

Play a key role in establishing and maturing enterprise program and project management capabilities at AAIS, supporting digital transformation and business modernization efforts.
Support the development and adoption of program and project management standards, templates, and toolkits.
Promote consistent use of delivery tools, governance processes, and execution rhythms across initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve delivery transparency, coordination, and execution discipline.

Requirements

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Strong knowledge of program and project management practices in complex, cross-functional environments, with the ability to lead multi-workstream initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
Demonstrated execution discipline, including the ability to translate ambiguity into structured plans, manage risks and dependencies, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance execution rigor with pragmatic delivery approaches.
Excellent facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively across business, technology, and external partners in a remote-first environment.
Proficiency with delivery management tools, collaboration platforms, and modern program management practices.
Working knowledge of organizational change management principles that support initiative adoption and sustainability.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Information Systems, or a related field.
8+ years of progressive experience in program management, project management, or delivery leadership roles, with responsibility for complex, cross functional initiatives.
Experience supporting enterprise transformation efforts, including digital modernization and process improvement initiatives.
Experience advancing delivery standards, tools, or practices within an organization.
PMP certification preferred.
Prosci Change Management Certification or equivalent change management experience preferred.
Ability to travel up to 10% for company meetings or planning sessions.

Minimum starting base of $125,000, with upward flexibility based on skills and experience + 10% annual bonus.

Salary Description

Min $125k base; see full pay details in job post

The Lead Project Manager will be responsible to lead cross functional teams in the planning and execution of all Government telecom projects. The Lead Project Manager must successfully implement and support projects, such as proposal support, project scheduling (Microsoft Project), operational support systems, ordering, inventory, transition/implementation performance reporting, budgeting/forecasting, training, customer care, operations, program management plans, change management plans, resource plans, quality assurance plans and risk management plans.

This position will give you the best opportunity to showcase your strong program management experience and knowledge of Generative AI innovations, Large Language Models (LLMs) and traditional machine learning (ML). Our work at NVIDIA is dedicated towards a computing model passionate about visual and AI computing. For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics, with our invention of the GPU. The GPU has also shown to be astonishingly effective at solving some of the most sophisticated problems in computer science. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Artificial intelligence is no longer science fiction. And in the next few years, it will transform every industry.

You will collaborate closely with teams, including engineering and product management for execution and alignment with organizational objectives. In partnership with such diverse stakeholders, you will be responsible for developing robust processes that ensure the successful execution and timely delivering of the software products. Inspect and assess projects’ health; provide input for corrections needed or help raise up issues for quick resolution. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements and have experience in large & complex program management. Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently are critical.

What You'll Be Doing

As Program Manager, you will be driving the release planning and collaborating with the Engineering and Product teams that are globally distributed across time zones.
You will be responsible for the overall consistency and coherence of specifications, setting quality standards and drive quality output of the software releases.
Speak objectively and constructively about what is working well and what needs to improve as we develop new processes.
Ensure that systems are in place to manage product feedback from customers as well as internal stakeholders.
Promote a positive environment across the organization by modeling behavior that promotes good morale.
Stay current with the state of the art in AI and scientific computing ecosystems.
Lead a mix of infrastructure, full-stack, and AI/ML solutions. Inspire the team with a sound technical vision and a vitality to execute by creating an inclusive team culture.
Continuous Improvement: Find opportunities for process improvements and optimizations. Collaborate to implement standard methodologies, drive efficiency gains, and enhance performance.

5+ years proven track record in technical program management or related roles. 3+ years of this experience should be engineering (coding) and machine learning and deep learning software architecture and frameworks.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or other technical field (or equivalent experience).
Experience leading programs building software products using AI technologies.
Deep hands-on experience with DL Frameworks (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.). Up to speed on generative-AI advancements.
Detailed knowledge of software engineering principles. Experience with industry standard configuration management tools. Experience with productivity tools and process automation.
Confirmed experience to creatively resolve issues and resource conflicts. Ability to think strategically and tactically and to build consensus to make programs successful.
Excellent knowledge of theory and practice of Generative AI and Large Language Models and specifically with NVIDIA GPUs and software libraries.

Strong written and oral communications skills, independent and able to multitask effectively with minimal day-to-day direction.
Ability to cultivate teamwork among teams composed of both technical and non-technical members.
You should be detail oriented with shown ability to multitask, in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities and changing requirements.
Proven track record to deliver complex products to customers.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and enjoy having fun, then what are you waiting for? Apply today!

Experience coordinating multiple technical and functional workstreams and working directly with Federal Government stakeholders and senior leadership.
Experience supporting stage-gate, cutover, migration-readiness, testing, and go-live decisions for enterprise implementations or migrations.

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

Location
: This hybrid role is based in our Tampa, Florida office. The current onsite expectation is two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays), with additional in-office presence as needed based on business needs.

Overview:

The Employee Experience Program Manager is responsible for bringing the organization's employee growth strategy to life through exceptional program execution, employee experiences, and operational excellence. Working closely with the Capability & Growth Leader and other People Team partners, this role helps build and scale the experiences that shape how employees join, learn, grow, and connect throughout their careers. From onboarding and leadership development to Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), performance processes, and career growth initiatives, the Employee Experience Program Manager plays a critical role in creating experiences that employees find valuable, engaging, and impactful. While this role manages day-to-day program operations, communications, logistics, reporting, and stakeholder coordination to ensure a consistent and high-quality employee experience, it is not just a traditional HR coordination role. The ideal candidate approaches employee programs with a customer mindset, continuously looking for ways to improve experiences, simplify processes, increase engagement, and drive measurable outcomes. We are looking for someone who is energized by building, experimenting, and leveraging technology—including AI-enabled tools and automation—to create scalable solutions for a growing organization. Operating within a lean and highly collaborative team, this role offers significant exposure to enterprise-wide initiatives and the opportunity to help shape the future of employee experience, learning, and growth. Success will require strong execution, curiosity, creativity, attention to detail, and a passion for continuously improving the employee experience. While experience in Talent Management, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or Human Resources is valuable, we are equally interested in candidates from Product Management, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, Community Building, Operations, Events or other disciplines focused on creating exceptional experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Design and continuously improve employee experiences using program participation, engagement, and effectiveness metrics and feedback to test new approaches and rapidly iterate.
Serve as an advocate for the employee experience by identifying friction points and proposing and implementing creative solutions that continuously improve usability, adoption and satisfaction.
Identify opportunities to increase efficiency, scale and employee engagement through automation, AI-enabled tools, and innovative technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of employee growth and learning initiatives.
Employee Engagement:
Coordinate and administer employee onboarding and orientation programs, ensuring a positive and engaging new hire experience.
Serve as a primary operational liaison for Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), supporting planning, communications, event coordination, and reporting.

Capability Building:
Manage logistics, communications, scheduling, registration, and participant support for immersive learning and employee growth initiatives.
Maintain and administer learning systems, development resources, career growth tools, program documentation, participation records, and reporting dashboards.

Growth:
Administer and support the performance review process, including timelines, communications, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.

General:
Coordinate internal and external events, including logistics, materials, vendor management, and attendee communications.
Support management of learning budgets, invoices, purchase orders, and related administrative processes.
Conduct research on industry trends, benchmark practices, and emerging solutions.
Lead and participate in special projects and initiatives as assigned.

Maintain compliance with lnovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement.
Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within lnovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position.
Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by lnovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company.
Uphold responsibilities relative to the separation of duties for applicable processes and procedures within your job function.
We reserve the right to change this job description from time to time as business needs dictate and will provide notice of such.

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) in a related field or comparable professional/career experience required

Experience:

5+ Years of experience in Human Resources, Learning and Development, Program Management, Employee Experience, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Operations, Community Management, Event Management, or a related field required

Skills and Abilities:

Demonstrated ability to coordinate and execute multiple programs, events or customer-facing initiatives simultaneously with a focus on adoption, engagement and outcomes.
Strong project coordination and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Experience leveraging technology, automation, AI tools or digital platforms to improve processes and employee or customer experiences.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and experience developing communications, presentations, reports, and program materials.
Strong customer-service and user-experience mindset with an ability to build positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.
Comfort working in environments with evolving priorities and the opportunity to build new processes, resources, and experiences from the ground up.
Strong analytical and reporting capabilities with experience monitoring participation and program metrics and the ability to translate participation data, employee feedback, and program metrics into actionable recommendations.
Ability to administer LMS.
Self-motivated with an ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and independently drive improvements with limited direction.
Experience supporting employee engagement, learning, onboarding, or culture-related initiatives preferred but not required.
Highly proficient skills in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, and related collaboration and learning technologies.

The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, or lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Materials Program Manager, Sustaining- Global Operations
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced innovative devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?

The Materials Program Manager (MPM) is responsible for the management and delivery of the product financial health for innovative, highly integrated consumer products. This person has a business orientation and is responsible for working within the local and remote operations, engineering and software teams driving development, implementation and management of the product budget. This person is the business voice responsible for capturing, documenting and communicating financial exposures and outlay as it relates to their product. They are involved throughout all stages of the product family's lifecycle to ensure Lab126 achieve all financial targets through end-of-life. They will support weekly executive product line reviews outlining performance against budget, target and actual cost.

Key job responsibilities

In This Role, You Will

Work with engineering and the supply chain team to set program cost targets at a commodity level for your project
Track the program actual costs versus target to identify program deltas and corrective actions to bring back on track
Attend program new product introduction meetings to understand the cost implication of engineering and/or process changes as related to you product fully loaded cost targets
Work with the OEM to set your product purchase order cost for the upcoming period
Manage purchase price variance claims resulting from engineering changes, component obsolescence or forecast variance
Drive the supply chain and operations team to provide detailed cost reduction forecast that enable you to meet and exceed your product goals
Work with the Lab126 Management team to ensure predictable, accurate forecasts for your products
Host weekly executive management cost reviews that deep dive through every aspect of your product cost

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
5+ years of supply chain management, planning, strategic sourcing, commodity management or program management experience
3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds
2+ years experience in the business procurement organization of a consumer market segment company
Experience in procurement practices working with engineering, supply chain and Tier 1 OEM partners

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree or equivalent
Experience with vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion or inventory management
Working knowledge of mobile technologies, products and tools preferable
Excellent analytical and communication skills
Ability to prioritize tasks and maximize internal resources
Experience leading and defining requirements and driving these across diverse organizations

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID

JR2013887

Job Category

Program Manager

Time Type

Full time

NVIDIA's deep learning platforms are at the forefront of innovation, profoundly impacting various fields and widely adopted by leading academic institutions, startups, and major Internet companies globally. We're seeking an accomplished and highly skilled Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our NVIDIA DGX Cloud team. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate, results-oriented, and creative individual to deliver exceptional value to our DGX Cloud customers. We are specifically looking for a TPM with extensive background in cloud infrastructure bring-up with external partners. You will play a key role in collaborating with CSPs, emerging cloud providers and engineering teams internally to help build AI capacity and infrastructure across the globe

What You'll Be Doing

As a DGX Cloud Technical Program Manager, you'll be a key partner to our Engineering, Infrastructure, Software teams and their leadership, driving critical programs related to AI capacity enablement and management. You'll play a pivotal role in developing and maturing foundational capabilities and processes for DGX Cloud, spanning critical areas such as cluster/capacity bring-up including CPU, storage, networking and compute requirements to support GPUs. This is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where TPMs are encouraged to apply fungible abilities to a range of high-impact programs within the DGX Cloud ecosystem.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Working in close coordination with storage engineering and network engineering teams to define and communicate requirements to CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Providers). Drive alignment and a POR for capacity blocks based on workload needs.
Drive early engagement with CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Providers) to understand their managed storage, network solutions and influence alignment with NVIDIA Cloud roadmap
Gathering technical requirements, developing comprehensive roadmaps, establishing clear milestones, and ensuring adherence to our Product Lifecycle (PLC) process.
Managing ongoing capacity operations and the engineering engagement with CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Provider) partners, collaborating closely with engineering leads. Focus on availability, maintenance and other critical performance indicators.
Partner closely within NVIDIA to understand workload requirements and related hardware and infrastructure needs. This includes speeds and feeds to optimize infrastructure readiness with cloud vendors and NVIDIA Cloud Providers.
Leveraging Jira and other program management platforms to instill rigor and structure in the management of engineering deliverables.
Identifying and driving opportunities to onboard the adoption of third-party and in-house cloud infrastructure solutions for deployments, support, security, compliance and observability across DGX Cloud
Establishing key performance indicators (KPIs) and quantitatively demonstrating the value and impact delivered by your programs.
Proactively identifying, resolving, and mitigating risks and issues that could affect scope, schedule, and quality across all program aspects.
Encouraging a culture of continuous improvement, consistently seeing opportunities for process improvements within our cloud infrastructure operations.

What We Need To See

10+ years of technical program management experience. You have driven the planning and execution of large-scale cloud infrastructure programs with outside organizations. You focus strongly on software engineering projects within a matrixed organization.
Extensive hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, preferably gained from working at a major Cloud Service Provider (CSP).
Domain knowledge in the bring-up and end to end operations of compute, storage and GPU (including common failure points at the HW and SW levels).
Expert-level proficiency with Jira, Smartsheet, or similar program management tools, with the ability to expertly guide engineering teams on their use of the tools.
Outstanding strategic and tactical thinking abilities, coupled with a strong capacity to build consensus and drive program success
Comfort and efficiency in growing within ambiguous environments.
Possess excellent communication and technical presentation skills, particularly for executive audiences.
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

In depth knowledge of NVIDIA GPU products, including deployment and bring-up
Working knowledge of various cloud technologies (Kubernetes, API integration, Terraform, etc)
A highly enthusiastic, energetic, responsive, and passionate individual with a keen eye for identifying process improvement opportunities.
Significant experience with productivity tools and process automation is a major plus.
Deep familiarity with cloud-native product / services environments and familiarity with AI, ML infrastructure, and cloud/services

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We offer attractive compensation and an extensive benefits package. While planning your future, explore what we provide for you and your loved ones at www.nvidiabenefits.com/ We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.

jobs.description:
Description

Are you passionate about solving complex global logistics challenges at scale? Join the International Seller Expansion Team, Amazon's fast-growing cross-border logistics platform that's revolutionizing how sellers ship inventory across the globe!

As a Senior TPM for Inbound Logistics, you'll drive critical initiatives that help scale our rapidly expanding platform to the next level of growth. You'll be at the forefront of solving complex technical and operational challenges as we expand our multi-carrier logistics network across international markets. This role offers the unique opportunity to own end-to-end technical program management for key platform scalability initiatives, focusing on architechting and executing solutions that enhance service performance, reliability, and availability.

In this role, you'll spearhead strategic initiatives to streamline carrier integration processes and optimize our technical infrastructure. You'll orchestrate complex cross-functional programs involving multiple Amazon teams and external carriers, while driving automation and optimization of operational processes to support our ambitious growth trajectory across cross-border logistics. Your expertise will be crucial in addressing critical platform challenges including service latency, system availability, and operational scalability.

Your scope will encompass multiple charters SEND, CRIS, ABACUS across its key strategic pillars: Pricing & Economics, Seller Experience, Platform Scalability, and Coverage Expansion. The ideal candidate will have strong technical depth, experience with large-scale distributed systems, and a proven track record of delivering complex programs in fast-paced environments.

This role offers the unique opportunity to shape the future of global e-commerce logistics while working with technologies and diverse stakeholders across Amazon's ecosystem. Come build the future of cross-border logistics with us!

Key job responsibilities

You will have end-to-end ownership the existing product suite along with scaling of all our cross-border products that has a multi-billion dollar entitlement and is part of a must-win goal with SVP level visibility.
You will setup optimal mechanisms to manage product delivery and scale the product.
You will collaborate with 8+ WW teams by driving QTRs, leading design reviews, engaging with leadership to ensure successful delivery of goals.
You constantly demonstrate are-right-a-lot by making build vs leverage decisions for key components of the product solution by making suitable tradeoffs. You take two way door decisions to optimize for speed of delivery when appropriate.
You setup suitable mechanisms to ensure that you are able to scale the adoption of the product seamlessly.
You will have a large ownership footprint as you evolve the tech stack act as the WW owner and be responsible for onboarding regional teams on to your tech solution.
Given the disproportionate leadership interest in this area, you establish good engagement mechanisms to manage stakeholders and leadership.

A day in the life

You lead brainstorming sessions with the SDEs and with external partners (upto L10 levels) to ensure the right decisions are made for product evolution.
You contribute to tech vision documents to articulate the long term vision of the product.
You collaborate with PM, SDM, WW partners to build solutions to solve complex problems to ensure the tech stack is evolving and moving towards the 3YP vision.
You operationalize new mechanisms and strengthen existing ones to ensure that your team scales with the growing demand for your product solution.
You work closely with 8+ VP orgs to influence them towards building scalable solutions that best serve our customers.

About The Team

We are an early stage start-up who have launched multiple global cross border logistics solutions are live in 25+ cross-border regions across NA, EU, JP, AU and AE marketplaces and are now looking to enhance the SX and scale the platform to 50+ new regions in the next two years. Our charter is of strategic importance to WW consumer leadership with S-team visibility. We are expanding our team as we are at the cusp of a breakout with this unique opportunity.

If you are an innovator and want to express yourself in a creative / fun environment you are looking at the perfect team. We are a bunch of fun-loving individuals who thrive on each other's success and work collaboratively to solve complex problems on behalf of our customers.

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience

Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

Department Overview

Motorola Solution’s Video Division is defining the future of the security industry through innovative end-to-end-solutions. We’re changing the landscape of the surveillance industry through advanced award-winning AI based surveillance systems. Artificial Intelligence is transforming the world and our team is advancing the field as it applies to the surveillance industry. We are proud to be industry leaders in video analytics with products like Appearance Search and Unusual Motion Detection along with our cloud service platform. You will have the opportunity to contribute to intelligent camera surveillance systems through cutting edge research and software engineering.

Job Description

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Video Security & Access Control (VS&A) Engineering organization. This is a high-impact role where you will drive the execution of complex, cross-functional programs that define the future of physical security—from AI-powered cameras to cloud-based access management systems.

In this role, you will report directly to the Sr. Director of Software Engineering for our Avigilon Unity portfolio, serving as a strategic partner to engineering leadership and a primary driver of technical delivery.

The Role

As a TPM, you are more than a project manager; you are a technical leader who understands the "how" as much as the "when." You will navigate the intersection of hardware, firmware, cloud software, and AI analytics. You will be responsible for orchestrating the entire product development lifecycle, ensuring that our roadmap is translated into high-quality, scalable solutions that protect people and property worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Program Lifecycle Management: Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex programs, managing dependencies across hardware, embedded software, cloud, and mobile teams.
Strategic Alignment: Work closely with the AVP of Engineering and Product Management to translate business strategy into actionable technical milestones and execution plans.
Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical bottlenecks, resource constraints, and cross-functional dependencies. Develop mitigation strategies to keep programs on track.
Technical Problem Solving: Dive deep into architectural discussions and technical hurdles. Use your engineering background to help teams make trade-offs between scope, schedule, and technical debt.
Stakeholder Communication: Provide transparent, data-driven updates to executive leadership. You will be the "single source of truth" for program health, budget, and timelines.
Process Excellence: Continuously improve the VS&A engineering execution model, implementing best practices for Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid methodologies as needed.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 8+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or Engineering Leadership, specifically within a product development environment.
Domain Expertise: Proven track record in one or more of the following: Physical Security (VMS/ACS), IoT, Embedded Systems, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS/Azure), or AI/Video Analytics.
Strategic Thinking: Experience working directly with executive-level leadership (VP/AVP level) to align engineering output with business goals.
Execution Focus: Expert-level knowledge of SDLC and hardware development cycles. You know how to get things done in a fast-paced, global organization.
Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and vice versa.

Target Base Salary Range: 120,000 CAD - 170,000 CAD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

Basic Requirements

5+ years of experience in technical program management or engineering experience

jobs.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to serve as the technical subject-matter expert (SME) for the Trust and Assurance team. This role will be responsible for leading the technical side of the compliance automation function of the team. A core part of the role is analyzing controls within the GRC platform to ensure they are accurate, meet framework requirements, and pull the necessary evidence to prove effectiveness. You will also partner with engineering teams to embed compliance into their workflows from the start. Strong compliance framework knowledge, solid program-management skills, and experience with AI technology are essential.

What You Will Do

Serve as the team's technical authority.

Act as the technical SME and primary point of contact for the Trust and Assurance team: interpret how systems and controls work, guide technical decisions, and identify opportunities to make workflows and tooling more efficient.

Manage compliance stack.

Oversee control mapping, evidence collection, and monitoring workflows, and manage the integrations that connect the GRC platform to cloud platforms and internal systems.

Establish control monitoring. Translate technical controls into automated, continuous checks, expanding monitoring coverage across the compliance stack and replacing manual reviews with ongoing monitoring.
Reduce audit burden.

Ensure every control has an accountable owner, support gap assessments and the rollout of new frameworks, and keep controls in a continuously audit-ready state.

Embed compliance into engineering.

Partner with engineering teams to build compliance requirements into their workflows and processes from the start, so compliance is designed in rather than added later.

Drive delivery and keep stakeholders aligned.

Manage initiatives through to completion, and communicate compliance risk, control status, and program progress to technical and non-technical audiences through clear, actionable summaries.

What You Will Bring

4+ years in GRC, compliance, or a technical role supporting cybersecurity programs, including leading programs and guiding or mentoring others.
Strong program and project management skills, with a track record of delivering across multiple teams.
Solid knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and/or FedRAMP) and hands-on audit experience.
Enough technical depth to be the team's technical point of contact: comfortable reasoning about cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), APIs, and data flows, and interpreting technical work with AI assistance, even if you do not write code.
Proven ability to lead technical discussions with engineers and subject-matter experts and ask the right questions to understand how controls and systems work.
Hands-on experience with a GRC or compliance-automation platform (e.g., LogicGate, ServiceNow, Drata), and comfort using AI tools in compliance workflows.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate between compliance and engineering for both technical and leadership audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Desired Skills:

Ability to write code or scripts (e.g., Python) to build automation directly.
Experience building AI/ML-powered or agentic applications, and with API integrations, CI/CD pipelines, or deploying production-grade services.
Technical background in systems administration, software engineering, cloud security, or security engineering.
Prior experience as a technical SME, or as a bridge between compliance and engineering teams.
Experience leading a SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or NIST 800-53 audit end-to-end, and familiarity with OSCAL or other compliance-automation tooling.
Familiarity with security monitoring tools (e.g., Tenable, Splunk), Git, and cloud infrastructure automation tooling (e.g., Terraform, Puppet, Jenkins).
Experience in SaaS, GovCloud, FinTech, or other highly regulated environments.
Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, CCSK, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.

Brief Description

About ECI

ECI’s mission is to be the global leader of professional consulting services for the life sciences industry. Our clients lean on our diverse perspectives and decades of expertise to tackle their toughest challenges and we take pride in providing them transformative solutions with distinctive, sustainable and long term value. ECI boasts a proven track record of providing full product life cycle consulting on a variety of challenging and exciting projects. Our collaborative culture, welcoming team and flexible employment & benefit options allow us to maintain strong relationships with the most talented individuals in the life sciences industry.
About The Role

The ideal candidate will manage Manufacturing Software and Sourced Finished Medical Device software-related workstreams within a medical device integration program. The role will support internal manufacturing software, supplier-managed software activities, software distribution, validation, release planning, production readiness, and transition-to-sustainment activities. This individual will work directly with internal cross-functional teams and SFMD supplier partners to align deliverables, dependencies, risks, documentation, and execution plans. The contractor will partner with Software Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supplier Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Cybersecurity, IT, and external supplier organizations to ensure software activities are completed in accordance with applicable medical device quality system requirements and software lifecycle standards. The successful candidate must bring strong project management discipline, hands-on Jira proficiency, Agile/Scrum operating experience, and practical experience delivering software projects in regulated medical device environments.
What You'll Do

Lead planning and execution of the Non-Product Software workstream across Manufacturing Software and SFMD software activities to support product integration and new product development efforts.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestone schedules, and project risks, and release plans.
Prepare concise status updates, leadership summaries, decision logs, and escalation materials for risk and issue resolution.
Coordinate internal and supplier-facing activities across software, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, operations, cybersecurity, IT, and supply chain stakeholders.
Coordinate requirements, design inputs, validation planning, test evidence, release readiness, deployment planning, and production support handoffs.
Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, and R&D to ensure internal software solutions meet business, production, and compliance needs.
Facilitate alignment between supplier deliverables and internal expectations for design controls, change control, validation, cybersecurity, risk management, and regulatory readiness.
Identify, track, and escalate dependencies between internal manufacturing systems, supplier-owned software solutions, product configuration, software distribution, and production release activities.
Ensure software project activities are planned and executed in alignment with regulated medical device software lifecycle expectations.
Support software planning, requirements management, verification, validation, traceability, risk management, change management, and release processes.
Facilitate design reviews, validation readiness reviews, risk reviews, defect triage, and audit-readiness discussions.
Track objective evidence and documentation deliverables required for software release, manufacturing implementation, medical device manufacturing integration, and sustainment transition.
Participate in agile planning activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily/weekly team synchronization, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
Maintain Jira metrics and dashboard for program-level reporting.
Partner with other project managers, leads, and functional stakeholders to clarify priorities and remove blockers.
Drive continuous improvement in Agile operating cadence, team accountability, and delivery predictability

What You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related technical discipline.
5 or more years of project or program management experience in the regulated medical device industry.
Demonstrated experience managing software development, manufacturing software, non-product software, or supplier-managed software projects in compliance-driven environments.
Experience working with internal cross-functional teams and external suppliers, including SFMD suppliers, contract manufacturers, or supplier software development organizations.
Strong working knowledge of medical device software lifecycle processes, design controls, validation, release management, risk management, and change control.
Required proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Agile/Scrum planning practices, backlog management, sprint execution, dashboards, and metrics reporting.
Strong facilitation, dependency management, risk management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to operate independently, drive clarity in ambiguous environments, and escalate risks with clear options and recommendations.
Certified Scrum Master or equivalent Scrum Master training or experience.
Experience supporting acquisitions, product integrations, supplier transitions, or quality system harmonization activities.
Experience with manufacturing systems, software distribution, configuration management.
Experience with Jira Advanced Roadmaps, portfolio reporting, Agile metrics, and executive-level dashboarding.
Familiarity with cybersecurity requirements for connected medical devices, manufacturing software, or supplier-managed software environments.

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

This position is for an Operational Security Manager in the Solutions Services Group (SSG). This is an exciting role that will give you the opportunity to work with Lenovo Engineering teams around the world to help Lenovo Business Units align with various regional, national and international security standards and regulations. You will be working alongside some of the best security teams in the industry. You will join a growing team of security professionals to protect and maintain the effectiveness of managed service capabilities.

The Operational Security Manager supports cybersecurity incident response, investigation, escalation, and regulatory reporting, with a focus on the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Working across Cybersecurity, Product Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Engineering, this role ensures incidents are properly assessed, documented, and reported within required timelines. The Operational Security Manager also provides technical leadership and continuously improves security processes, controls, and supporting technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

Support the full cybersecurity incident response lifecycle, including triage, investigation, containment, escalation, remediation, recovery, and post-incident review across enterprise and product environments.
Coordinate incident response activities across Cybersecurity, Product Security, Engineering, IT, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and external partners, including support for critical incidents outside normal business hours when necessary.
Assess incidents and actively exploited vulnerabilities affecting products marketed or sold in the EU to determine applicable handling and notification requirements, particularly under the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
Coordinate timely and accurate regulatory notifications, ensuring required incident, product, impact, mitigation, and remediation information is gathered, validated, documented, and communicated.
Maintain incident records, regulatory assessments, reporting decisions, evidence, and chain of custody in support of internal, legal, audit, and regulatory requirements.
Strengthen incident response readiness through playbooks, tabletop exercises, lessons learned, metrics, automation, and improvements to monitoring and investigation capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Significant experience leading cybersecurity incident response or security operations, with demonstrated knowledge of the full incident response lifecycle.
Experience investigating incidents across product, application, cloud, infrastructure, network, endpoint, and third-party environments.
Working knowledge of EU cybersecurity regulatory requirements, particularly the incident and actively exploited vulnerability notification requirements of the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
Strong understanding of threat and vulnerability analysis, digital forensics, evidence preservation, chain of custody, and technologies such as SIEM, endpoint security, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management platforms.
Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear incident assessments, escalation decisions, executive communications, and regulatory notifications.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage high-pressure incidents and meet operational and regulatory deadlines.

What We Offer

An international team with a high focus on Gender Diversity.
Employee Assistance Program, e.g., for psychological, legal financial consultancy
You are joining a company that prioritizes sustainable solutions like CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio.
Access to training for personal development - Internal E-learning Development Platform Available for Employees
Mentorship program

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. A Little More About Your Role…

You will be central to the highly collaborative Services South team; based across the Heathrow office primarily.

Your role will be at the heart of our high performing team, using your skills and expertise to help us continue driving forward in terms of both technical quality and service efficiency; whilst leading the teams senior engineers in their day to day project management activities.

What You’ll Be Doing

Leadership: Leading and mentoring design team members, ensuring effective communication and coordination across multidisciplinary design teams. Driving collaboration between MEP, structural and architectural disciplines to deliver coordinated, compliant and technically robust design solutions aligned with programme, budget and quality expectations.
Design Management: Developing and managing design delivery plans, including design programmes, deliverables, and review stages. Leading the setup and coordination of design scopes, managing design inputs within Task 99 structures, and ensuring appropriate allocation of time and resources across design activities and deliverables.
Technical & Design Performance: Supporting the monitoring of design effort against programme and budget, working closely with project and commercial teams to track design progress, resource utilisation, and alignment with cost constraints. Contributing to monthly project reviews with a focus on design performance and risks.
Business Development: Supporting tender bids from a technical and design management perspective, including development of design methodologies, programmes, and resourcing strategies. Collaborating with wider WSP teams to bring in specialist capability and support integrated design solutions across opportunities.
Client Relations: Building and maintaining relationships with client technical teams, contractors, and stakeholders. Communicating design intent clearly, responding to technical queries, and aligning design outputs with client requirements to support effective and coordinated delivery.
Compliance & Assurance: Supporting design governance processes, including design reviews, coordination checks, and stage gate requirements. Contributing to compliance with relevant standards, Heathrow requirements, and internal quality processes, while maintaining clear documentation of design decisions and changes.

Your Team

Our team is comprised of approximately 60 engineers working across the Mechanical, Electrical and Public Health specialisms
Our team is split across our Brighton, Southampton, Heathrow, Basingstoke and Guildford offices giving the flexibility or work in either location on any given day. Many of our team choose to alternate the office they work in to suit personal and client needs.
As part of our team, you would be working on some of our major projects predominantly at Heathrow Airport. This will be as part of a multi-disciplinary offering and so experience in building services, structural and civil engineering disciplines will be an advantage.
You will be reporting to our Director that manages the various Frameworks at London Heathrow.
You will be able to utilise graduate, assistant, senior and principal engineers in supporting roles around you, as well as dedicated BIM and Sustainability specialists to contribute to the successful delivery of your projects.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Extensive experience in design management within the Building Services sector, within aviation or similarly complex, regulated environments.
Experience in leading and coordinating multidisciplinary design teams, including management of design programmes, deliverables, and interfaces across MEP, structural, and architectural disciplines.
Demonstrable capability in managing design processes, tools, and systems (including BIM, digital design platforms, and coordination tools), ensuring alignment with project and programme requirements.

jobs.title: Business Change & Technology Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

SRLV is a mid-tier firm of chartered accountants, business management specialists and corporate and private client advisors based in London’s vibrant West End. Founded in 1988, we have evolved into a £30m+ turnover business with 21 partners and 240+ staff supporting an enviable roster of A-list corporate and private clients worldwide.

From international restaurant groups and luxury retail to well-known names in music, entertainment and sport, our clients are inspiringly diverse and rewarding to work for. Their varied interests mean that teams often work collaboratively across our four divisions. This gives our people the freedom to work both individually and as one multi-specialist client team so we’re always learning, from intern right through to partner.

Founded on the principles of a family business, people are the beating heart of our business. Relationships of trust, whether with our staff, clients or professional network are the bedrock of what we do; people and relationships come first. We see everyone as individuals and aim to create an environment where everyone feels welcomed, supported and free to be themselves. There is no single career path at SRLV. Our people succeed in different ways, at different stages of their careers. It is a nurturing culture where everyone is encouraged to thrive.

The Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Business Change & Technology Project Manager to join SRLV, a leading London‑based accountancy firm. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in turning technology and process‑improvement ideas into fully delivered, embedded and adopted changes across the practice. This business‑facing position combines structured project management, clear business analysis and practical change management to drive existing initiatives through to completion, enhance departmental workflows, improve and standardise the use of existing software, and help identify appropriate AI and automation opportunities.

A key focus of the role is reducing unnecessary demands on partners and managers while ensuring professional oversight is maintained. Working closely with the IT Partner, fractional Chief Information Officer and IT Manager, who retains responsibility for day‑to‑day technology operations, infrastructure, support and cybersecurity—the Business Change & Technology Project Manager will ensure that improvements are well‑designed, thoroughly tested and successfully adopted across the firm.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery
Review and assess all current projects, establishing clear scope, status, ownership, risks and outstanding decisions.
Manage projects agreed by the IT Committee from initial definition through implementation, adoption and final handover.
Coordinate internal teams and external suppliers to ensure effective delivery and alignment with project objectives.
Maintain project momentum, proactively escalating delays, resource constraints and unresolved decisions to relevant stakeholders.
Provide regular reporting on progress, risks, costs and required decisions to project sponsors and the IT Committee.

Initial projects may include FibreCRM, cloud migrations for audit, accounts preparation and tax applications, driving adoption of Xero as the firm’s preferred financial accounting system, inbound post process improvements and credit control enhancements .

Workflow and Business Analysis
Engage with chargeable and administrative departments to understand existing processes, pain points, duplication and manual effort.
Map current and proposed workflows to support clear analysis and solution design.
Translate business needs into structured requirements, implementation plans and measurable outcomes.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise or automate processes to improve efficiency and consistency across the firm.

Software, AI and Automation
Review the firm’s existing systems to assess consistency, effectiveness and alignment with intended use.
Identify unused functionality, duplicate systems, workarounds and training gaps.
Recommend whether issues should be addressed through process change, configuration, integration, automation or new technology.
Develop and prioritise a pipeline of practical AI and automation opportunities aligned with business needs.
Coordinate controlled pilots with defined objectives, measurable outcomes and clear evaluation criteria.
Ensure all solutions incorporate appropriate safeguards relating to confidentiality, personal data, security, accuracy and human oversight.
Work closely with the IT Manager when assessing, selecting and evaluating potential solutions.

Change and Adoption
Involve staff and partners in the design, testing and refinement of new processes and systems.
Prepare clear communications, guidance and training materials to support successful adoption.
Monitor usage of new systems and processes to ensure correct and consistent application.
Address poor adoption, workarounds and unintended consequences through targeted interventions.
Conduct post implementation reviews to confirm whether expected benefits have been achieved and identify further improvement opportunities.

Qualification, Experience and Skills

Our people bring curiosity, motivation and a desire to develop—thoughtful individuals who contribute to high‑quality client service and collaborate effectively across the firm. When expanding our teams, we look for people who bring different perspectives, strong analytical thinking and a commitment to continuous improvement.
To be considered, you should ideally have:

Essential
Proven experience combining business analysis, project management and change delivery, with a strong track record of leading initiatives from definition through implementation and adoption.
Demonstrable experience mapping, analysing and improving operational workflows, including identifying inefficiencies, duplication and manual effort.
Strong stakeholder‑management and workshop‑facilitation skills, with the ability to engage partners, managers and staff across all departments.
Ability to challenge established practices constructively, offering clear, evidence‑based recommendations for improvement.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, including coordination of suppliers, management of risks and dependencies, and maintaining delivery momentum.
Ability to translate business needs into clear requirements, structured plans and practical implementation steps.
Excellent communication, documentation and organisational skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and accessible manner.

Desirable
A recognised project management qualification, such as PRINCE2, APM PMQ, AgilePM or equivalent.
Experience working within an accountancy practice or regulated professional‑services environment.
Familiarity with practice‑management, accounting, CRM or document‑management systems, and how they support operational workflows.
Practical experience of AI, workflow automation or low‑code solutions, including identifying suitable use cases or supporting pilot activity.
Understanding of data protection, information security and responsible AI principles, and how they apply to process design and technology adoption.

Benefits
